title: Preserve bounded reasons for strict-Save absence recovery refusal
outcome: Consolidated Claude7134 Medium at src/engram_session_reconciliation.rs:123 and :204. Target lookup errors and serde admission errors are discarded, and one generic refusal covers ownership/status/generation/token/grant families. Preserve bounded contextual reasons, distinguish families without exposing routing tokens or entire receipts, and test missing or mistyped receipt fields plus representative fence refusals. Maintain fail-closed behavior and the strict Save 409 envelope; do not introduce automatic retries or new producer refusal categories. No source edits authorized by this review.
